churches.pastor: Shawn Johnson (Senior Pastor, founding pastor since 2005)
churches.services: Multiple campuses — check website for times
churches.assessment: Red Rocks Church is a fast-growing megachurch founded by Shawn Johnson in 2005. Started in a theme park and grew to 9 campuses. Johnson is known for his mental health focus and authored 'Attacking Anxiety.' The church is seeker-sensitive with a heavy emphasis on emotional/mental health. Has been on Outreach magazine's Fastest Growing and Largest Churches lists. While Johnson appears theologically conservative on paper, the seeker-sensitive megachurch model and therapeutic emphasis may indicate shallow doctrinal depth. Verify preaching style and gender theology locally.

churches.overall_label: YELLOW — Female Children's Pastor Title, Verify Gender Theology
churches.assessment: Valley Creek Church Flower Mound is a large, active multi-campus church (4 physical + online). Website at valleycreek.org. Led by Senior Pastor John Stickl. The listed address (4040 Valley Pkwy) does not match current (5800 Long Prairie Rd). NOTE: Dawn Shapley holds the title 'Children's Pastor' -- female in a pastoral title. While Children's Pastor is not a senior/teaching elder position, the use of 'pastor' title for a woman is a YELLOW flag per complementarian standards. Four campuses suggest megachurch size. Review needed on gender theology and ecclesiology.
